key_points: Stock is technically oversold after an 11% decline over four weeks, with Wall Street analysts raising earnings estimates — suggests potential near-term stabilization but is largely a quantitative/technical signal.
Super El Niño risk to consumer/restaurant stocks represents a genuine fundamental threat to supply chains and consumer traffic that warrants monitoring over the coming months.
Institutional selling by Squarepoint Ops and Engineers Gate is routine portfolio rebalancing and not thesis-changing.
Valuation arguments citing strong cash flow and earnings suggest the stock may be attractively priced on a longer-term basis.

Combined effect is mixed — oversold bounce potential and supportive valuation are offset by macro/weather risk and institutional selling, making the overall picture neutral rather than clearly directional.
